title: Cross-process race between real TagDuel Discord Accept handler and five-minute expiry sweeper
priority: P1 — the fourth-seat tag:accept component at deadline-1ms must race safely with the five-minute TagDuel expiry worker at the exact deadline.

design.isolation: Temporary SQLite database with independent Node processes/connections; parent connection closed before races.
design.concurrency: Three races: handleTagComponent(tag:accept) for the final seat at deadline-1ms versus tagStore.dueTags at deadline.
design.clock: Deterministic Date.now per process; idempotent expiry retry reconciles a transient SQLite lock conflict.

assertions: Accept either commits a complete four-seat TagDuel or fails closed after expiry
the terminal lobby revision advances exactly once
playing outcome has four accepted seats, four physical tag_members locks and a valid TagDuel state
expired outcome preserves the three earlier acceptances, has null state and releases all four locks
no duel_members locks are created by a TagDuel lobby race
public Discord payloads pass validateDiscordPayload and physical card UIDs remain unique when playing
players, player_cards, starter_grants, decks and deck_cards remain unchanged
limitations: Handler Discord.js real executado offline com interação falsa; sem token, gateway ou guild real.
SQLite temporário e relógio determinístico; não mede latência de produção.
